notes: PROSPECT SUMMARY: Northstar Minutiae builds programmatic ad matching and live personalization for publisher networks. Very latency-sensitive: bidding pipeline needs sub-30ms end-to-end p95 on model scoring (reranker + price-suggest). High qps at peak (30k-50k reqs/s across EU+NA).

WORKLOAD DETAILS: primary workload = reranking + short-context personalization. Also embeddings for cold-start audience match. Sessions are sticky (user cookie -> session KV). They want prefix/KV cache support to avoid re-encoding long contexts for repeat bidders.

PERF SLOs & COST TARGETS: target p95 <= 30ms tail for scoring path. Cost goal: incremental model cost <= $0.08 per 1k scoring calls at target throughput (internal target from finance). Very sensitive to per-token cost; interested in unit economics of batching vs latency tradeoffs.

MODEL PREFERENCES: prefer open models for auditability. Suggested candidates: Llama2-13B/13B-chat, Mistral medium, internally quantized 8-bit/4-bit variants. Want Redwood recommendations on quant profiles and fallback to a smaller model under overload.

OPTIMIZE INTEREST: explicit ask for batching/caching/quantization guidance. Wants automated batching policy examples (max latency budget 10ms for batching window, burst handling), intelligent prefix caching for session tokens, and quantization profiles (int8, q4_0) with measured quality delta.

BENCHMARK REQUESTS: asked Redwood for microbenchmarks comparing: 13B int8 on A10 vs 13B int8 on H100, batching sizes 1/4/16, streaming vs non-streaming, and KV cache hit vs miss. Also request: p50/p95/p99 latency histograms and tokens/sec under sustained qps. POC must include reproducible harness + sample input set (they will provide 10k real anonymized scoring traces).

POC SCOPE: Redwood to provision a dedicated test pool, run 7-day perf run simulating peak diurnal traffic, provide cost model and configuration that meets p95 target. If met, expand to canary in production behind routing policy.

SECURITY & COMPLIANCE: PCI scoping question — ad-ops billing touches payment tokens; security team needs confirmation on data residency and retention controls. They require SOC2 + SSO/SAML + audit logs for all token access. KMS integration mandatory for customer keys.

QUOTES FROM PROSPECT: 'We cannot trade off tail latency for cost at peak — a missed bid is lost revenue.' 'If you can prove 15-20% cost reduction with no >5ms p95 regression, we can greenlight Dedicated pool.'

DECISION CRITERIA: meets p95 SLA + clear cost savings model + security signoff + predictable autoscaling. Also prefer vendor with easy rollout path (canary/A-B) and strong tracing/per-route cost telemetry.
